title: The Brave Little Seed
summary: A tiny seed is afraid of the dark under the ground… will she find the courage to grow?

scenes.text: Deep down in the earth lived a very tiny seed. Everything around her was dark and quiet. The little seed felt a little afraid. "What if I stay down here forever?" she thought, curled up in her small shell. Far, far away in the night, she heard an owl. Just like you do when you snuggle into your bed, the little seed closed her eyes and breathed. Little by little, the fear grew smaller, and the earth held her warm and safe.

One morning the rain trickled down through the earth in tiny drops. The water came close and spoke to her in a whisper: "Hello, little one. I have come to give you a drink." The drops wet her with love, and the seed felt something new: a warm wish to stretch. She was still afraid of the dark, but the rain sang her a very soft song. "Don't rush," it said. "Growing happens slowly, and gently." The little seed drank and drank, and inside she began to feel a little bit stronger and braver.

The day came when the little seed had to grow upward. The path was dark, and she did not know what waited at the end. "I am afraid," she said quietly. But she remembered the rain's song and was very brave. Very calmly, she pushed a tiny green arm up through the earth. She pushed, and pushed, and pushed. From up above she was called by a soft wind: "Come, you are almost here." Her roots held on tightly down below, like little hands, and the sprout climbed and climbed toward the light.

And then… the little seed came out into the light! She opened her first leaf to the sky and saw the sun shining warm and golden. "I did it!" she said, and up from inside her bubbled a happy giggle. The sun greeted her with a warm ray, and the breeze danced through her leaves. It was no longer dark or scary. The little plant understood that growing was worth it after all. All around her the birds were singing, and the world was wide, green, and bright.

Many nights and many suns went by. The brave little seed became a big, strong tree, with branches that hugged the sky. When night came, it was covered in silver light by the moon. Among its leaves twinkled the stars. Beneath its branches the birds slept, calm and cozy. The tree remembered, happily, that little seed who was once afraid in the dark. And now, just like you, it closed its eyes slowly. Good night, brave little seed. May you grow lovely while you dream.
